intro.author: Paul, writing through a scribe named Tertius (16:22)
intro.audience: House churches in Rome, a mix of Jewish and Gentile believers
intro.setting: Paul had never visited Rome, though he had long wanted to (1:10-13). He was about to carry a gift of money from Gentile churches to poor believers in Jerusalem, and he hoped afterward to visit Rome on his way to Spain (15:23-28). The Roman believers met in several homes, and Jewish and Gentile Christians did not always see eye to eye.
intro.purpose: Paul sets out the gospel he preaches in its fullest form, both to introduce himself to a church he hoped would support his mission west and to help Jewish and Gentile believers accept one another.
intro.bigIdea: In the gospel God reveals a righteousness that rescues everyone who believes, Jew and Gentile alike.

outline.title: Made right with God by faith

commentary.t:
THE EPISTLE OF PAUL THE APOSTLE TO THE ROMANS

Commentary by David Brown
